notes.title: DevLog #01 - Reload The Machine!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, I am very excited to share with you the features I developed in Laundry Service Simulator in my devlog series. This is my first post![/b]

You know, a washer's fuel is of course detergent and the softener :D
Here are some liquid physics I developed for my game;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183606/fa58d4c8e0599e4807bdf0bc04f4d2cceabab78e.gif[/img]

Remember in the laundromat, you should always keep your detergent stock full and reload your machine!

Feel free to give me any feedback and comment.
If you want to stay up to date about my game Laundry Service Simulator, [b]follow my Steam page and add to your wishlist![/b]
